summary: Iteration 35 — wardrobe launch simplification (branch recovery-implementation-2026-09-10) fully verified. BACKEND (6/6 pytest passed): (a) /api/ health OK, (b) POST /api/items and GET /api/items still work with the reviewer account for all 46 seed items across every category (Tops/Bottoms/Dresses/Outerwear/Shoes/Bags/Accessories/Jewellery), (c) categories round-trip unchanged, (d) POST /api/items/bulk-delete removes them cleanly, (e) backend module loads cleanly after the ANALYZE_SYSTEM prompt wording change (server responds 401 on /items unauth, prompt file inspected — includes the new bodysuit/corset/cami/halter/crop/polo/vest → Tops guidance and the explicit garment-type vocabulary). FRONTEND (Playwright, mobile viewport 390x844, reviewer email/password login): 46 items seeded via /api/items. Wardrobe tab opens on TOPS by default (filter-chip-Tops active) — filter-chip-All does NOT exist anywhere. Verified for EACH of the 7 categories with subfilters (and Dresses with none): (i) exact subfilter chip labels + order matches spec — Tops [T-Shirts,Shirts,Blouses,Polos,Singlets,Camis,Crops,Halter,Long Sleeve,Vests,Bodysuits,Corsets], Bottoms [Jeans,Pants,Shorts,Skirts,Leggings], Outerwear [Blazers,Jackets,Coats,Cardigans,Jumpers], Shoes [Sneakers,Boots,Heels,Flats,Sandals,Dress Shoes], Bags [Handbags,Backpacks,Clutches,Briefcases,Crossbody], Accessories [Hats,Sunglasses,Scarves,Ties,Belts,Gloves], Jewellery [Necklaces,Bracelets,Earrings,Rings,Watches]; (ii) NO subfilter-chip-Other anywhere; (iii) sum(chip counts) == items shown for every category (Tops 13=13, Bottoms 5=5, Outerwear 5=5, Shoes 6=6, Bags 5=5, Accessories 6=6, Jewellery 5=5); (iv) Dresses shows 0 subfilter chips; (v) tapping a subfilter chip narrows results (Blouses -> 1 item), tapping again clears to baseline (13). Special classification checks: (A) waistcoat surfaces under Tops>Vests AND NOT under Outerwear, (B) hoodie surfaces under Outerwear>Jumpers, (C) 'TEST35_Black long-sleeve bodysuit' stored with category=Dresses is hoisted to Tops>Bodysuits (Dresses category displays only 1 item, the plain midi dress). SMOKE: item tap opens /item/{id}, select mode + cancel-select work, Shopping Intelligence banner present, Home shows home-plan-week, Dress Me shows dressme-activity prompt. All 46 seed items deleted via /api/items/bulk-delete (deleted=46). Zero failures across 32+ frontend assertions and 6/6 backend tests.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/wardrobe.tsx L19: FILTERS = [...CATEGORIES] — no 'All' entry, launches straight into a category (default Tops via lastFilter=FILTERS[0]). Correct.

L58-119 SUB_RULES: order per category is 'most specific cue first' so items resolve to exactly ONE label (bodysuits/corsets/halter/crops/polos/vests/camis/singlets all evaluated ahead of the generic T-Shirts/Blouses/Shirts matches). Vests match on both /vest|waistcoat|gilet/ AND is placed under Tops. Correct.
L75-81 Outerwear rules: 'Vests' entry is removed (was previously in Outerwear list); Jumpers rule now includes hoodie|sweatshirt so hoodies land under Outerwear>Jumpers. Correct per spec.
L37-55 displayCategory: BODYSUIT_RE hoists any bodysuit/leotard/unitard to Tops regardless of stored category — verified with the seed item stored as Dresses. Correct.

L123-132 SUB_ORDER: exposes only the labels listed for each category (Dresses omitted -> no subOptions -> no subfilter row). L199-201 filters subOptions to only chips with count>0 so 'Other' (assigned internally by primarySub L142) never surfaces as a chip. Correct.

backend/server.py L1485-1510 ANALYZE_SYSTEM: prompt updated to include the bodysuit/corset/cami/singlet/halter/crop/polo/vest → Tops guidance and the explicit shopper-vocabulary garment list. Compiles/loads cleanly (backend healthy, all API endpoints responding).

Note (informational, non-blocking): Tops SUB_RULES L69 T-Shirts regex still matches 'jersey' anywhere in name/style/fabric/description. In this seed the Olive long sleeve top has fabric='cotton jersey' AND style contains 'long sleeve', but the T() concatenation makes 'long sleeve' resolve to Long Sleeve FIRST because SUB_RULES.Tops T-Shirts rule fires on /jersey/ only if 'long ?sleeve' hasn't already matched — however Long Sleeve is item 12 in the SUB_RULES order (below T-Shirts at item 9). It actually classified correctly here because the T-Shirts regex requires t-?shirt|tshirt|tee|jersey top|crew neck|scoop neck|v-neck tee|jersey (as a standalone match). The item's style 'long sleeve top' does not contain 'jersey' at word boundary that hits — verified this in the run (Long Sleeve chip=1, T-Shirts chip=1, both correct). Same cosmetic nit flagged in iteration_34.json still applies for items whose description literally names 'jersey' without 'long sleeve'.
